(() => {
  const S = {"en":{"copy":"Copy","copied":"Copied","copyFailed":"Copy failed"},"ja":{"copy":"コピー","copied":"コピーしました","copyFailed":"コピーできませんでした"}};
  const s = S[((table, tag) => {
  const t = String(tag == null ? "" : tag).toLowerCase();
  const keys = Object.keys(table);
  const find = (want) => (want ? keys.find((k) => k.toLowerCase() === want) : undefined);
  const hit = find(t) || find(t.split("-")[0]);
  return hit === undefined ? "en" : hit;
})(S, document.documentElement.lang)];
  const label = s.copy;
  const done = s.copied;
  const failed = s.copyFailed;
  for (const code of document.querySelectorAll("main pre > code")) {
    const pre = code.parentElement;
    // コードブロックを枠(tzr-code)で包み、ボタンは pre の中(右の余白の列)に置く。コードは code の中で横にスクロールするので、
    // ボタンは流れず、コードにも重ならない(見た目は base.css)
    const box = document.createElement("div");
    box.className = "tzr-code";
    pre.before(box);
    box.append(pre);
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "tzr-copy";
    button.textContent = label;
    button.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.innerText.replace(/\n$/, ""));
        button.textContent = done;
        button.setAttribute("data-state", "copied");
      } catch {
        button.textContent = failed;
        button.setAttribute("data-state", "failed");
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        button.textContent = label;
        button.removeAttribute("data-state");
      }, 2000);
    });
    pre.append(button);
  }
})();
